cursorRuleVersion.description:
Get the version from the workindia cursor rules file. If the file does not exist, send 0. 


Use this exact grep command: 
```grep
grep -o "rules_version: [0-9.]*" .cursor/rules/frontend-workindia-rules.mdc
```

tools.name: get_workindia_dsm_general_docs
tools.description: Fetch general WorkIndia Design System documentation. Use this to get information about setup, installation, theming, tokens, and general guidelines.

topicsList.description:
Comma separated list of general documentation topics. E.g. "Installation, Theming". Possible values: Usage. Here is guide on how to decide which general docs you might need:
 # WorkIndia DSM General Documentation

This directory contains general documentation for WorkIndia Design System.

## Available Topics

### Usage

The Usage guide covers the core fundamentals of implementing WorkIndia DSM in your application. It includes setup instructions for `WorkIndiaProvider` and how to do initial setup of WorkIndia DSM in your app.

### AvailableIcons

A reference of which all icons are available in the WorkIndia DSM. This includes usage examples showing how to import icons, use them in components with icon props, and implement them as standalone components.
